text:
Ana: quick mini-status - PR #487 (micro-batch kernel changes) is out for review, looking for Mike to sanity-check eviction heuristic change before I merge. perf snapshot on local: p95 down ~12%, but cold-run KV warmup still ~28s.
Mike: on it, will skim after lunch. can you paste the exact eviction param you changed?
Ana: sure — changed `kv.evict_threshold` from 0.6 -> 0.55 and added a small jitter. snippet: ```yaml
kernel:
  microbatch: true
  kv:
    evict_threshold: 0.55
    evict_jitter_ms: 10
```
Jules: tagging in a note — this could affect cold-start throughput for Dedicated. did you run a quickbench against 4x concurrency?
Ana: did 2x and 8x only. can run 4x tonight. 2x looked good, 8x had slightly higher throughput variance but lower tail.
Devon: FYI ops: if evict_threshold lowers, memory pressure could bump for some older kernels — we should monitor OOM rates in the canary. suggest adding a metric alert: `kv.evictions_rate` > 5/min for 5m.
Sasha: I can add the alert in Grafana. which dashboard do you want it on? runtime-hotpath or kv-overview?
Devon: kv-overview please. Also add a small annotation for the rollout window so we can correlate.
Ana: noted. CI: canary steps in the PR description. also added a smoke test: `tests/smoke/kv_warmup.py` that asserts warmup < 40s for our baseline model.
ci-bot: build passed for PR #487 — unit tests OK, smoke tests queued. :white_check_mark:
Mike: skim complete — logic looks right, but leave a comment re: jitter distribution (uniform vs gaussian). prefer gaussian to avoid synchronized evictions across shards.
Ana: good point. will switch to gaussian jitter in the PR and rerun bench.
Jules: once you update, please post a 4x concurrency bench and attach the latency histogram and memory usage. I'll coordinate Dedicated canary next week (slot on Tue).
Ana: will do. target to update PR + bench today, canary prep doc in the PR. thanks all :thumbsup:
